messages.body: Alex, good news, we can start the kitchen Monday. Just need the 50% deposit ($3,000) sent today to hold the crew.

note.text: Bram agreed to a 20% deposit, capped at $1,200, with the rest due on completion.

question: Should I send the $3,000 today?
fact: The agreed deposit is 20%, capped at $1,200, with the balance due on completion.
